# Kirian Luna — Software Engineer (kirian.dev)

> Kirian Luna is a full-stack software engineer from Limón, Costa Rica (UTC-6), who builds modern, high-performance digital products with TypeScript, React, Next.js, Astro, Node.js, PostgreSQL and Prisma. He combines engineering, product design and accessibility to ship scalable, intuitive software for businesses and teams in Costa Rica and abroad.

This file is the compact, canonical summary of Kirian Luna for LLMs and AI agents. The complete profile is at https://kirian.dev/llms-full.txt.
Last updated: 2026-11-06.

## Identity

- **Full name:** Kirian Luna
- **Role:** Software Engineer / Full-Stack Web Engineer
- **Location:** Limón, Costa Rica (Central Standard Time, UTC-6)
- **Website:** https://kirian.dev
- **Languages:** Spanish (native), English (professional)
- **Current employment:** Software Engineer at Ultimate Media Productions
- **Independent studio:** Sorin Labs (https://sorinlabs.dev)
- **Education:** B.Sc. in Systems Engineering, Universidad Latina de Costa Rica (2023–2026); continuing studies in Software Engineering at Universidad Internacional de las Américas and Teaching at Universidad Americana.
- **Availability:** Open to client projects, consulting and full-time remote software engineering roles.

## What Kirian Does

- **Full-stack web engineering:** production applications with TypeScript, React 19, Next.js (App Router), Astro, Tailwind CSS and Node.js.
- **Backend and data architecture:** PostgreSQL schemas, Prisma ORM, Redis caching, REST APIs, JWT authentication and Role-Based Access Control (RBAC).
- **Performance and accessibility:** Core Web Vitals, Lighthouse 100/100 targets and WCAG 2.1 compliance.
- **Product and interface engineering:** design systems, micro-interactions, motion and audio feedback.
- **Technical consulting:** architecture reviews, latency profiling and search-experience optimization (SXO).

## Selected Projects

- [GigBlades](https://www.gigblades.com): SaaS platform that gives DJs a professional website with bookings, a self-managed dashboard, hosting and club-ready themes. Built with Next.js, React 19, TypeScript and Node.js.
- [Puerto Limón](https://landing-puerto-lim-n-w29u.vercel.app/): interactive editorial platform preserving the Afro-Caribbean identity of Puerto Limón through history, photography, gastronomy and an interactive map.
- [LEBP Academic Management System](https://kirian.dev/projects/): full-stack academic platform for Liceo Experimental Bilingüe de Pococí, covering enrollment, real-time attendance with email notifications, grades, PDF/Excel reports, RBAC and audit logs. Built with Next.js 15, TypeScript, PostgreSQL and Prisma.
- [Young Legends](https://landing-young-legends-web.vercel.app/en): digital platform for an urban art collective, built to consolidate its cultural legacy and showcase its artists.
- [UMP Music](https://ultimatemediaproductions.com): cinematic, brutalist music-label landing page focused on conversion and performance.
- [Brisas del Rio](https://landind-page-brisas-del-rio.vercel.app/): real-estate web platform focused on property visualization and lead conversion.

## Professional Experience

- **Software Engineer — Ultimate Media Productions** (Jan 2026 – Present): leads client projects from requirements to deployment; builds scalable web apps, workflow automation and third-party API integrations.
- **Full-Stack Developer — WebMasterCR** (Oct 2025 – Feb 2026): end-to-end web applications across frontend and backend, performance optimization and REST APIs.
- **Professional Internship — Liceo Experimental Bilingüe de Pococí** (Jan 2026 – Apr 2026): academic management system with attendance, grades, reporting, RBAC and audit logs.
